messages.text: Will it pay for itself?

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. You're buying a shot at a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, for years, plus steady sats to your own wallet. The B30 is $899, 405 W — about $29/month at 10¢.

What do you pay per kWh?
How much money we can make a day
Ran the power-cost calculator · 12¢/kWh

Day by day it's small — the sats from 30 TH/s land in cents, not dollars, and power runs about $35 a month at 12¢ (roughly $1.15 a day). The real draw is the block shot: every ten minutes your B30 takes a swing at 3.125 BTC, forever.

What's your actual rate per kWh? I'll run the exact sats and odds for you.
How long i need to pay off the miner

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. People buy it for the block shot: 3.125 BTC drawn every ten minutes, year after year, and you still own the machine. Plus sats straight to your own wallet, no exchange, no KYC.

Tell me your rate per kWh and I'll show you the real monthly numbers and your odds.
Where i can find thats rate ?

On your electricity bill — look for the price per kWh, usually near the usage chart. Most US homes land between 10 and 20 cents.

Or just tell me your state or country and I'll use the local average.
I see 0.249
Ran the power-cost calculator · 24.9¢/kWh

At 24.9¢ the B30's 405 W works out to about $73 a month in power. That's the honest number — the sats won't cover it, and that's not why people run one.

What you get is a real draw at 3.125 BTC every ten minutes for years, sats landing in your own wallet meanwhile, and a piece of the network you can actually see and show people.

At that rate, the Magic M. 40T at $799 is the better value per TH — more hashrate, lower price. Want me to put one in the cart?
Ok
Searched the catalog · Magic M. 40T
Built a cart

Cart's ready — Magic M. 40T, $799, Batch 6, ships November 21, 2026:

(order link hidden)

One straight number so you're not surprised: it pulls 650 W at 40 TH/s, about $117 a month at your 24.9¢. It also runs an eco mode, 30 TH/s at 450 W, around $81. Your call on which mode.
Is the electricity supply the rate or different things .

Different things, usually. Supply is what the energy itself costs per kWh; delivery or distribution is a second per-kWh charge on the same bill. Your real all-in rate is both added together.

Easiest check: take the bill total and divide by the kWh used that month. If 0.249 was supply only, your true rate is higher — tell me the number and I'll redo the monthly cost.
207 kwt

That's your usage for the month, not the rate. Divide your bill total by 207 and that's your real all-in rate per kWh.

Worth knowing: the 40T running 24/7 adds about 470 kWh a month — more than double what your whole home uses now. Eco mode is about 325 kWh.

What's the bill total?
I pay 30.18$

$30.18 ÷ 207 = about 14.6¢ a kWh. Much better than 24.9¢.

At that rate the 40T costs about $68 a month at full 40 TH/s, or $47 in eco at 30 TH/s. The B30 at 405 W would be about $43.

Your cart's still live for the 40T at $799, ships November 21 — more hashrate per dollar, which is more draws at the block. Good to go?
Thank you

Wich one is batter

The 40T. It's $100 cheaper, 40 TH/s against 30, so more draws at a block for less money. Ships November 21.

The B30 only wins if the monthly bill matters more than hashrate — 405 W, about $43 a month versus $68. Ships November 30.

For most first buyers, the 40T.
Thank you
